_about: LGD urban local bodies (civic.ulb, 2026-11-13) of MP, MH, RJ, GJ, GA, DD: code -> [state, district, name, local name, type]. th_dist.lgd_of() ties a body name read from a district page to one of these within the page's district. alias: names a page writes that LGD writes in another way (state|district|name as the page writes it -> code), each checked by hand.
